title: System Design
description: Design systems that stay fast, correct, and available, following Designing Data-Intensive Applications: from one server to replication, partitioning, transactions, consensus, and streams. Estimate load, stress architectures in the traffic simulator, and build a storage engine, a consistent-hash partitioner, and Raft in Python. Ends with a capstone: design a Twitter timeline that survives spikes, partitions, and crashes.
author: FreeKnowledge contributors
